contract.task_clause:
Let G = (V, E) be a connected, undirected graph, and let a and b be two distinct vertices in V. Let P_1 be the problem of finding a shortest simple path between a and b, and let P_2 be the problem of finding a longest simple path between a and b. Which of the following statements about P_1 and P_2 is true?
Option A: Both P_1 and P_2 can be solved in polynomial time.
Option B: P_1 can be solved in polynomial time but P_2 is not known to be solvable in polynomial time.
Option C: P_1 is not known to be solvable in polynomial time but P_2 can be solved in polynomial time.
Option D: It is not known whether either P_1 or P_2 can be solved in polynomial time.
